items.title: Qnity Electronics (Q) Unveiled Ultra Thin Flex Circuit Materials At TPCA 2026
items.summary: Qnity Electronics (NYSE:Q) introduced new ultra thin flex circuit materials for smart devices at TPCA 2026 in early November. The flex materials target next generation smartphones, AI glasses, and AR/VR hardware that require tighter bends and lighter components. Qnity Electronics used the TPCA 2026 showcase to highlight materials aimed at supporting further miniaturization in consumer electronics designs.
